Presenting the Plymptoons Collection by legendary animator Bill Plympton, the true King of Indie Animation. Spanning over 35 years of his remarkable career, this Collection brings together iconic animation from Academy Award nominated films “Your Face” and “Guard Dog,” alongside unforgettable works including “The Tune,” “Push Comes to Shove,” “Hair High,” “Footprints,” “The Wiseman,” and “The Loneliest Stoplight.” This Collection also features a completely new and exclusive animation created especially for this release, marking its premiere within the Collection. The Plymptoons Collection is now available on our website. #collections #klydoclock #indieanimation #billplympton

It’s a wrap for CES 2026, and what a time it was! We brought Living Media to the show, with animated content created by our artist community displayed across all our clock styles, plus a HUGE Klydoclock that stole the spotlight (and is already in the works to turn into an actual product😮). We reconnected with old friends, met new ones, and were especially inspired by Klydoclock owners who stopped by to share how much they love what we’ve done so far and how excited they are for what’s coming next. Oh...and we had 12 very lucky visitors who won🎰 a Klydoclock! Until next time!

Let every second be fabulous! Time meets art in this Ashley Longshore × Klydoclock collaboration, presenting her vibrant collection of animated art. This collection is available exclusively in Ashley Longshore’s limited-edition Klydoclocks, preloaded with her signature content. Ashley Longshore: “I love Klydoclocks because they bring my art to life in such a fun, unexpected way - bold colors, playful shapes, and unexpected details that make every glance feel like a burst of joy. They’re functional, but with the soul and wit of my art. These beauties feature a whole collection of my art animated and switching every morning, a daily reminder that life is meant to be lived in color.” The Ashley Longshore Klydoclocks can be found at ashleylongshore.com and in person at the Ashley Longshore Pop-Up, 47 Great Jones Street, New York City. Link available in our bio! #ashleylongshore #exclusive #klydoclock #collections

We’re proud to share that Klydoclock is now part of MoMA Design Store. To be selected by MoMA Design Store is a meaningful acknowledgment of what we’ve been building, uniting time, art, and technology in one living design. As MoMA describes it: “The Klydoclock brings together two concepts that we and the Museum are passionate about: clocks as everyday useful objects and artist-created animation… Some of the myriad animations offered by the Klydoclock, such as Ub Iwerks and Walt Disney’s Steamboat Willie (1928) and motion studies by Eadweard J. Muybridge, are featured in MoMA’s collection, while others represent our commitment to celebrating graphic design.” #moma #momadesignstore #design #art #tech #time

Collections
Introducing Klydo Collections, a new way to experience time on your Klydoclock. Collections are curated themes that expand your library with fresh visuals, sounds, and moods. Each one is crafted by artists to bring a distinctive atmosphere to your space. Going beyond single looping animations, Collections are full creative concepts built around unique ideas and themes, featuring added layers like ambient soundscapes, distinctive chimes, and more surprises coming soon. Collections are offered as paid content that adds extra experiences to your Klydoclock, while the ever-growing feed of daily Klydo animations remains included. Collections are about bringing more of your personality into Klydoclock - shaped by what you love and whatever makes you tick. Now available on our website! #collections #klydoclock #themes
